name: scrape-corpus-golden
description: Quick smoke-test golden set (5 queries) from arXiv Attention paper and W3Schools Python crawl. Re-upload with replace to refresh the DB copy.

items.query: What is the scaled dot-product attention formula in the Transformer paper?
items.response: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V — dot products of the query with all keys, scaled by sqrt(d_k), then softmax weights applied to values.

items.query: What network architecture does the Transformer paper propose instead of recurrence and convolutions?
items.response: The Transformer — a sequence transduction model based solely on attention mechanisms, without recurrence or convolutions.

items.query: What are variables in Python according to W3Schools?
items.response: Variables are containers for storing data values.

items.query: Compare the WMT 2014 English-to-German and English-to-French BLEU scores reported for the Transformer big model.
items.response: English-to-German: 28.4 BLEU; English-to-French big model: about 41.0–41.8 BLEU. Both exceed prior state-of-the-art results on those tasks.

items.query: Does the scraped W3Schools content explain how to implement a Transformer in PyTorch?
items.response: No — the indexed W3Schools pages cover Python variables, the homepage, and Academy marketing content, not a PyTorch Transformer implementation guide.
